_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F05, before the chapter's boss: Grey Mask on the stairs.

text.zh_TW: 樓梯上站著一個人——灰色的面具，沒有表情。
text.en: Someone stands on the stairs: a grey mask with no face.

text.zh_TW: 灰面：「農夫家的小鬼，居然自己送上門。省得我們去找。」他打了個響指，一頭巨獸從陰影裡走出來。「把他打昏，帶上來。別弄壞了。」
text.en: Grey Mask: "The farmer's brat, walking right into our hands. Saves us the search." He snaps his fingers and a huge beast steps out of the shadows. "Knock him out and bring him up. Don't break him."

text.zh_TW: 灰面沒有回答。他轉身走上樓梯，消失在黑暗裡。
text.en: Grey Mask doesn't answer. He turns and climbs the stairs into the dark.
